name: Festi hf.
summary: Festi hf., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail sale of fuel in Iceland. It operates through Krónan, N1, and ELKO segments. The company operates 68 fuel service stations, 11 electricity service stations in co-operation with ON, and one methane service station for vehicles; 27 service stations that offer refreshments and healthy snacks under the Nesti brand; 11 lubrication and tyre garages; and six corporate stores and 52 maritime fuel pumps. It also operates 22 convenience stores under the Krónan and Kr brand names; two convenience stores under the Kjarval brand name; a store under the Nóatún brand name; five electronic stores under the Elko brand name, as well as an online store; and a warehouse hotel that provides product storage, packing, labelling, and product distribution services under the Bakkinn brand. It also leases non-residential real estate properties. The company was formerly known as N1 hf. and changed its name to Festi hf. in September 2018. Festi hf. is headquartered in Kopavogur, Iceland.
